extra.reason: Captured and documented local hardware facts in Research/rig-kontrol-3.md; added rk3probe to reproduce USB/HID/MIDI visibility checks.
Added SwiftPM scaffold with RigKontrol3Core, rk3probe executable, README, research log, and build/test commands.
Added CoreMIDIVirtualSource plus MIDI note/CC message construction and UMP word tests.
Added default switch/expression mapping, expression calibration, deadband filtering, and unit tests.
Added libusb descriptor probe and bounded bulk reader. Verified device opens, configures, claims interface 0 alt 0, enumerates endpoints, and receives packets from bulk IN 0x81.
Added reusable bulk packet diff analysis, surfaced packet delta output in rk3probe, documented zero-based change offsets, and verified with unit tests plus a short hardware capture.
Documented DriverKit fallback decision, concrete trigger conditions, Apple entitlement/signing path, local USBDriverKit SDK availability, and current reason to stay on app-level libusb.

Added rk3probe --guided-capture with baseline, switches 1-9, toe switch, and expression sweep windows; added configurable --step-seconds, cross-step packet comparison, tests, docs, and hardware smoke verification.
Added --capture-log JSONL export for guided capture, with structured packet records, tests, documentation, and hardware smoke verification.
Added core guided capture log analyzer, rk3probe --analyze-capture offline CLI mode, tests, docs, and smoke verification against a JSONL capture log.
Added missing expected step summaries to guided capture log analysis, surfaced warnings in rk3probe --analyze-capture, updated docs, and verified with tests plus sparse-log smoke output.

Added baseline-changing offset detection, per-step candidate offsets, CLI output, tests, and updated hold/longer-window capture guidance; verified against the first capture and confirmed it is inconclusive.

Controlled capture was performed and produced enough evidence to implement the packet parser for switch-mask and expression packets; unresolved physical labels are documented for follow-up rather than blocking parser implementation.
Decoded the verified raw packet format, added RigKontrolPacketParser, parser/calibration tests, decoded analyzer output, and documentation; unverified controls are split into a follow-up issue.

Focused capture Captures/rk3-remaining-controls.jsonl recorded 103 records across all 4 focused steps. Switch 2 emitted mask 0x20, not 0x10; switch 9 emitted mask 0x00 only; toe switch emitted no switch-report packet. No new default parser mappings were added; README and Research document the evidence and unmapped controls.

Clean all-switch capture Captures/rk3-all-switches-clean.jsonl recorded 276 records across all 19 release-window steps with no missing windows. Switch 1 emitted mask 0x10; switch 2 emitted mask 0x20 and parser/tests were updated accordingly. Switch 9 toe-down emitted no switch-report mask and only expression movement, so no switch 9 mapping was added; README and Research document this.
Implemented rk3bridge live CoreMIDI bridge, streaming USB bulk reader, parser-to-MIDI pipeline tests, launch docs, and successful bounded hardware smoke test.
